providerSubstitution.seam: A Node ESM loader redirects only the upstream test's exact webgpu package import to the selected provider wrapper; upstream tests, generated WGSL, function corpus, dependency resolution, compilation-info checks, and cleanup remain unchanged.

runtimeOwnershipPlan.incumbentLimitation: The pinned incumbent currently aborts before a fair paired verdict and controls when generated-WGSL compiler and diagnostic fixes become available to the application.
runtimeOwnershipPlan.applicationConsequence: The unchanged 110-function corpus can lose CI coverage or actionable compilation diagnostics while waiting for an incumbent release.

materialOutcome.metric: complete unchanged assertion and generated-shader coverage with exposed native diagnostics and clean process completion
materialOutcome.decisionRule: Promote DoeRuntime only if D0 passes the frozen corpus and materially exceeds W0 and the smallest reviewable P0 correction on coverage or failure localization.

I1.construction: Pinned packaged Dawn Node WebGPU binary that reproduces the incumbent boundary.

W0.construction: I1 with the identical corpus oracle, diagnostics capture, receipts, replay, and release policy.

D0.construction: DoeRuntime with the same provider seam, corpus, and DoeProof contract.

P0.construction: W0 plus the smallest reviewable incumbent correction that reaches the same compilation and diagnostic boundary.

fallbackPolicy.providerIdentityAssertion: The selected wrapper and child-process provider probe must name the requested module, expose an adapter identity, reject software renderers, and bind an accessible physical render node before evidence is comparable.

workload.sameWorkPolicy: Both providers execute the same pinned 13-assertion upstream test file over the same generated 110-function corpus; the parent additionally rejects native compiler diagnostics that getCompilationInfo failed to expose.
workload.completionBoundary: A clean-process sample ends only after the Node test parent and worker exit, the 13-assertion summary is captured, provider-native compiler diagnostics are classified, and cleanup completes without a timeout.

performancePolicy.timingScope: complete clean-process Node test execution of the pinned 13-assertion upstream suite plus native-diagnostic classification
performancePolicy.throughputMetric: oracle-passing complete WGSL compilation suites per second
